name: Library Management System
author: Online Web Tutor

sections.description:
Library Management System (LMS) turns your WordPress site into a complete, working library. Catalogue your books, register your borrowers, issue and return copies, collect late fines, print receipts, and give every member their own portal — all without writing a single line of code.

Most book plugins give you a list of titles. If you are searching for the best library management system plugin for WordPress, the difference here is scope: master records, copy-level tracking, a full circulation workflow with fines and receipts, member self-service, migration tooling and a public catalogue — presented in a distraction-free workspace with dark and light modes.

It ships in three editions — Free, Basic PRO and Full PRO — so you begin at no cost and move up only when your collection genuinely outgrows the edition you are on.

Why Choose Library Management System?

📚 A catalogue that reflects your actual shelves — Categories, publications, authors, languages, bookcases, sections and branches are all first-class records, defined once and reused everywhere. A single title can carry several authors and several languages, so translations, co-authored works and multi-edition holdings stay accurate instead of being squeezed into one field.

🔄 Circulation handled end to end — Issue and return titles through a structured loan transaction, record the condition a book comes back in, calculate overdue charges against your own fine rate, and hand the member a receipt at the counter.

👥 Members who can serve themselves — Every borrower gets a signed-in portal for searching the catalogue, reviewing current and past loans, and retrieving receipts. Permission settings decide exactly how far that access reaches.

🎨 An interface your staff will actually use — A full-width, distraction-free workspace with dark and light appearance modes, adjustable theme colours and typography, and a responsive layout that holds up at the issue desk, on a tablet in the stacks, or on a phone.

📤 Your data stays yours — Every listing exports to Excel, CSV or PDF, and every module supports CSV import and export. Migrating a spreadsheet-based catalogue in, or pulling figures out for a board report, is never a barrier.

🌐 A public face for your collection — Publish your holdings to any page or post with a flexible shortcode, narrowed to the categories, authors or specific titles you want on display.

🌍 Configured for your institution — Country, currency and fine-rate settings, with the interface available in English, Hindi, Italian, Spanish and French.

🚀 Evaluate before you commit — Install demonstration data in one click and explore a fully populated library before entering a single real record.

🛡️ Built the WordPress way — Capability checks, nonces and sanitisation throughout, so the plugin behaves predictably alongside the rest of your site.

Perfect For

✔ Schools, colleges and universities
✔ Coaching institutes and training centres
✔ Community, public and church libraries
✔ Corporate, research and departmental libraries
✔ Clubs, societies and private book collections
✔ Anyone who wants the best library management system plugin for WordPress without a monthly SaaS bill

✨ Free Version — What You Get ✨

The free edition is a working library system in its own right, not a preview of one.

A Workspace Built for Library Staff
* A full-width, distraction-free portal that keeps circulation work on one screen instead of scattering it across WordPress sub-pages
* Dark and light appearance modes, with theme colour and typography controls so the system carries your institution’s identity
* A card-based dashboard that surfaces stock levels, membership figures and open loans the moment you sign in
* Considered empty states with a rotating quote panel, so a fresh install reads as ready rather than broken
* A responsive layout that stays usable at the issue desk, on a tablet during shelf checks, and on a phone

Cataloguing That Matches Real Collections
* Dedicated master records for categories, publications, authors, languages, bookcases, sections and branches — entered once, reused everywhere
* Masters are created automatically as you type them into a book form and immediately become suggestions across the system
* A title accepts several authors, so edited volumes, translations and co-authored works are recorded accurately rather than flattened into a single name
* A title also accepts several languages, letting one entry represent every edition variant you actually hold
* Tag-style categorisation places a work under every subject it genuinely belongs to
* Copy-level tracking with unique accession numbers, so each physical item remains individually identifiable
* Full bibliographic detail per title: ISBN, cover image, stock and description

Membership Records
* Complete borrower profiles covering contact, membership and branch details
* Each profile opens onto that member’s current loans, answering “who has this book?” without a separate search
* Branch association keeps statistics meaningful across multiple locations

Circulation and Charges
* Structured issue and return handling for every loan, with the condition of each returned item recorded at the desk
* Overdue charges calculated automatically against the fine rate you set
* A downloadable receipt issued on return, giving the member proof of settlement and your desk an audit trail
* Complete borrowing and return history retained for every title and every member

The Member Portal
* A signed-in self-service area where members search the catalogue and filter it on the criteria that matter to them
* Members review what they currently hold, what they have already returned, and retrieve their own receipts
* Access is permission-driven, so you decide precisely which areas each member reaches
* Administered entirely from the WordPress side — no separate system to maintain

Data Portability
* Any listing exports to Excel, CSV or PDF for audits, stock-taking and board reporting
* CSV import and export on every module, so an existing spreadsheet catalogue can be brought across in minutes
* One-click demonstration data for evaluating the system, training staff or piloting a workflow before going live

Public Presence
* A shortcode that publishes your holdings on any page or post, with attributes to narrow the display to a category, an author or specific titles
* Paginated browsing, filtering and a full detail view for every work

Regional and Language Settings
* Country, currency and fine-rate configuration
* Public page display and shortcode behaviour under your control
* Interface available in English, Hindi, Italian, Spanish and French

Limitations of the Free Version

The free edition is sized for smaller collections and single-handed operation. These are its boundaries, stated plainly:

  • Record ceilings — Each module holds up to 30 records: categories, bookcases, sections, branches, titles and members
  • One title per transaction — A checkout covers a single book; issuing several titles together arrives in Basic PRO
  • A fixed lending term — Every loan runs for 30 days and cannot be adjusted; configurable terms arrive in Basic PRO
  • No reporting module — Consolidated reports and statistics begin at Basic PRO
  • No database diagnostics — Integrity checks on your library tables begin at Basic PRO
  • No backup or restore — Snapshotting and recovering your library is a Basic PRO capability
  • Records are handled one at a time — Cloning, and bulk delete, activate and deactivate across modules, begin at Basic PRO
  • Limited data tooling — Import and export cover the essentials; broader data management and maintenance workflows come with the paid editions
  • No member requests — Members cannot submit borrow or return requests for staff approval; available from Basic PRO
  • No WordPress account import — Turning existing site users into members in one action is Full PRO
  • No member self-service circulation — Self-checkout and self-return from the frontend, with optional staff approval, are Full PRO
  • No reservations — Placing a hold on a title that is currently out is Full PRO
  • A single administrator — Additional Librarian and Circulation Staff roles are Full PRO
  • No permission matrix — Deciding what each role may see and do is Full PRO
  • No automated correspondence — Email templates and notification rules are Full PRO
  • Fixed form fields — Adding, hiding and reordering form fields is Full PRO
  • Fixed portal wording — Rewriting the portal’s labels and messages is Full PRO
  • No commercial channel — Selling PDFs and eBooks through WooCommerce is Full PRO

In short: Basic PRO lifts the ceilings and adds the operational tooling a busy collection needs. Full PRO adds delegation, automation and member self-service on top.

Basic Premium Features

Basic PRO keeps every free capability and removes the constraints that hold a growing collection back.

➜ Unrestricted capacity — Every record ceiling is lifted. Catalogue as many titles, members, categories, bookcases, sections and branches as your collection actually requires.

➜ Multi-title checkout — Issue several books to a member in a single transaction, the way a real issue desk works, instead of repeating the process one title at a time.

➜ Lending terms you define — Replace the fixed 30-day period with durations that match your own policy, whether that is a fortnight for popular fiction or a full term for reference material.

➜ Reporting and statistics — A dedicated reporting area that turns circulation activity into figures you can act on and present: what is moving, what is idle, who is overdue.

➜ Database health checks — Verify the integrity of your library tables and catch structural problems before they interrupt service.

➜ Backup and restore — Capture a complete snapshot of your library whenever you choose and restore it to the same site or a different one. Indispensable before a migration, a major upgrade or end-of-term archiving.

➜ Cloning and bulk actions — Duplicate an existing record as a starting point, and delete, activate or deactivate records in batches rather than individually.

➜ Member request workflow — Members submit borrow and return requests from their portal; your staff approve or decline them. Convenience for the member, control at the desk.

➜ Extended data tooling — Broader import, export and maintenance options than the free edition provides.

Reserved for Full PRO: WordPress account synchronisation, member self-checkout and self-return, reservations, multi-librarian roles and permission control, automated email correspondence, form field and portal wording customisation, and the WooCommerce sales channel.

Contact onlinewebtutorhub@gmail.com to learn more about Basic PRO.

Full Pro Add-ons

Full PRO is the complete system: everything above, plus the delegation, automation and self-service capabilities larger libraries depend on.

➜ WordPress account synchronisation — Convert existing site users into library members in a single action, filtered by the roles you choose, instead of re-entering hundreds of records by hand.

➜ Member self-checkout and self-return — Let members issue and return titles themselves from the frontend, with optional staff approval before anything is committed to the ledger.

➜ Reservations — A member places a hold on a title that is currently out and is first in line when it comes back, so popular works keep circulating instead of being missed.

➜ Delegated staffing — Distinct Librarian, Circulation Staff and Library User roles, so responsibilities are properly separated rather than shared through one administrator account.

➜ Permission control — Decide precisely what each role may see and do, module by module.

➜ Automated correspondence — Professionally designed email templates and notification rules that keep members informed of due dates, returns and charges without manual follow-up.

➜ Form field management — Add, hide and reorder the fields on your forms so the system records exactly what your institution needs, and nothing it does not.

➜ Interface wording control — Rewrite every label and message in the member portal to match your own terminology, whether that is “patron”, “member” or something specific to your organisation.

➜ Barcode circulation — Generate barcodes for titles and individual copies, issue and return by scan, and produce barcode sheets in bulk for an entire accession run.

➜ Graduated return charges — Separate penalties for late returns, damaged volumes and missing pages, rather than a single blanket fine.

➜ Announcements — Publish notices to members directly inside their portal.

➜ WooCommerce bookstore — Sell PDFs and eBooks alongside your lending collection, using the storefront and payment gateways you already run.

Additional Notes

We would be happy to assist you anytime.
If you are interested in a paid edition or custom development, feel free to contact us via email onlinewebtutorhub@gmail.com.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard
1. Visit ‘Plugin > Add new’.
2. Search for ‘Library management system’.
3. Activate Library management system from your Plugins page.

From WordPress.org
1. Search, select and download “Library management system”.
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress Dashboard.

After activation, open Library Management System > Settings > Data & Tools and run the sample data installation if you would like to explore a fully populated library first.
sections.faq:
Is LMS plugin free of cost for lifetime?

Yes. The plugin will always be available for Free with no hidden charges. We also offer two paid editions — Basic PRO and Full PRO — which you can buy whenever your library needs more.

What is the difference between Free, Basic PRO and Full PRO?

Think of it as three questions. How large is your collection? Free holds 30 records per module; Basic PRO and Full PRO have no ceiling. How does your desk operate? Free issues one title per transaction on a fixed 30-day term; Basic PRO adds multi-title checkout, lending terms you define, reporting, database health checks, backup and restore, cloning and bulk actions. Who else is involved? Full PRO brings delegation and automation — staff roles with permissions, account synchronisation, member self-checkout and reservations, automated email, barcode circulation, form and wording customisation, and the WooCommerce bookstore.

What are the limits of the free version?

Thirty records in each module — categories, bookcases, sections, branches, titles and members — with one title per checkout and a fixed 30-day lending term. The “Limitations of the Free Version” section above sets out every boundary and the edition that lifts it.

Can one title carry more than one author or language?

Yes, in every edition including Free. Both fields accept multiple values, so edited volumes, translations, co-authored works and multi-language holdings are recorded accurately instead of being forced into a single entry.

Can members sign in and see their own loans?

Yes, in the free edition. Members get a portal where they search the catalogue, review what they currently hold and what they have returned, and retrieve their own receipts. Permission settings determine exactly which areas each member reaches.

Can I get my data out of the plugin?

Yes, and this is free. Every listing exports to Excel, CSV or PDF, and every module supports CSV import and export — so bringing an existing spreadsheet catalogue in is as straightforward as taking figures out.

Can members check out or reserve titles themselves?

Self-checkout, self-return and reservations are Full PRO capabilities. If you want member convenience while keeping control at the desk, the request-and-approve workflow in Basic PRO is the middle ground: members ask, your staff decide.

Is the LMS plugin compatible with other WordPress themes and plugins?

Yes. It works with standard WordPress themes and plugins and should not conflict with your existing setup.

Do I need to know any coding to use this plugin?

No. Library Management System is built to be extremely easy to use and manage — no coding required anywhere.

How can I purchase a premium version of the plugin?

The plugin is free to download. To purchase Basic PRO or Full PRO, send an enquiry to onlinewebtutorhub@gmail.com and you will receive a reply with the details to proceed.

My LMS Premium version license key is not working…

If you have license key verification issues with your premium LMS setup, please make sure your website runs over https:// (an SSL certificate must be enabled).

Can I use the plugin on multiple sites?

No, the license key is issued for a specific WordPress site.

Is plugin data backup feature available?

Yes, from the Basic PRO edition upward. You can take a plugin data backup anytime and restore it later to the same website or a different one.

Do you provide support?

Yes. Our LMS support team is available at onlinewebtutorhub@gmail.com.
sections.changelog:
3.6.8

  • New book field — Internal Library Code: Every book can now carry your own classification or shelf code (for example E3.7.1 TEN) alongside its ISBN, matching the Full PRO edition. The field is optional and sits on the Add/Edit Book form
  • Stored on the books table: An internal_code column is added to the books table on upgrade, so existing catalogues keep every record and simply gain the new field
  • Shown wherever a book is presented: The code appears in the admin Book Catalog list, in the Library User (LMS) catalogue cards, on the single book page in the portal, in the book detail and checkout overview modals, and in the public book detail modal. It is hidden when left blank
  • Searchable: The catalogue free-text filter now matches on the internal code as well as ISBN, title, author and price
  • Sample data includes it: Install Sample Data now seeds an internal code for each demo book
  • CSV and Excel import/export updated: internal_code is the sixteenth column of the books sample file and is read back on import. Re-download the sample file before importing books — a books file with the old fifteen columns is now rejected with a message naming the expected columns
  • Inactive books can no longer be borrowed: Issuing an inactive book from the admin Borrow screen is refused, self-checkout from the public library page is refused, and approving a pending checkout request for a book that has since been deactivated is refused
  • Inactive books stay hidden from members: Deactivated titles were already excluded from the public catalogue, the Library User catalogue, the single book views and the book detail modal — the borrow paths now match that, so an inactive book is neither visible nor obtainable
  • Public library page uses the full page width: The /wp-library-books/ catalogue now breaks out of narrow theme content columns on desktop, expanding up to 1600px instead of being squeezed into the theme’s text column
  • Four cards per row on wide screens: With no layout preference saved, the widened page shows four books per row from 1400px up. Cards per row set under Settings » Library Page Layout continues to take precedence
  • Navigate to Library Page removed from Settings: The duplicate button has been dropped from the Settings screen — the View Library button in the top header covers it on every page
  • View Library button in the top header: The plugin workspace now carries a View Library button in the top header, matching the Full PRO edition
  • One click to the public catalogue: The button opens your public library page — the /wp-library-books/ page holding the [owt7_library_books] shortcode — in a new tab, so you can check how a title looks to visitors without leaving your work
  • Available to every LMS role: WordPress Admins, Librarians and Library Users all see the button, so the public catalogue is one click away from any portal screen
  • Finds the page even if it was moved: The link resolves the catalogue page by its slug and, failing that, by the shortcode it contains, and it is hidden altogether when no such page exists
  • Compact on small screens: On tablets and phones the button collapses to its icon, keeping the top header uncluttered
  • Public library page rebuilt to match Full PRO: The /wp-library-books/ catalogue now uses the same layout, spacing and card design as the PRO edition, so the free page no longer looks like a stripped-down version of it
  • Theme styling can no longer bleed into the catalogue: Every catalogue element — filter bar, heading, book cards, covers, details, footers, buttons and pagination — carries its own namespaced class, so themes and other plugins styling generic names such as book-card, filter-bar or pagination can no longer alter the page
  • Filter bar hidden while the catalogue is empty: Category, Author and free text filters are shown only when there is something to filter, so a library with no books published no longer greets visitors with an empty filter row
  • Two distinct empty states: A library with no books explains that the catalogue is empty and to check back soon, while a filter that matches nothing invites the visitor to change or reset the filters — each with its own icon
  • Pagination hidden on an empty result: The pagination row is no longer printed when there are no books to page through
  • View button restyled: The catalogue View button now matches the PRO edition — icon and label aligned, consistent height and rounded corners, and full width on phones
  • Public View settings still respected: Cards per row, fonts, card background, and View button colour, padding and placement continue to apply to the rebuilt page

3.6.7

  • Security fix — SQL injection in the list filters: The “Books by Category”, “Sections by Bookcase” and “Users by Branch” filters passed the selected value straight into the database query. A signed-in user could craft that value to read data they were never meant to see, including WordPress account records
  • Filter values are now strictly numeric: The selected value is validated as a whole number the moment it is read, so all three filters are covered by a single check
  • All three queries now use prepared statements: Each filter query binds its value through a numeric placeholder instead of building the query as text
  • Permission check added: The filter request now confirms the caller is allowed to view that module — book, section and borrower lists each require their own listing permission, so subscribers and other non-library roles are refused
  • Module and filter pairing locked down: Only the three intended module/filter combinations are accepted, and the list template loaded in response is chosen from a fixed internal list rather than from the request
  • Reported by João Ramos Maciel, coordinated through Erwan Le Rousseau of the WPScan and Jetpack security team. Our thanks to both

Library Management System (LMS) turns your WordPress site into a complete, working library. Catalogue your books, register your borrowers, issue and return copies, collect late fines, print receipts, and give every member their own portal — all without writing a single line of code.

Limitations of the Free Version

The free edition is sized for smaller collections and single-handed operation. These are its boundaries, stated plainly:

  • Record ceilings — Each module holds up to 30 records: categories, bookcases, sections, branches, titles and members
  • One title per transaction — A checkout covers a single book; issuing several titles together arrives in Basic PRO
  • A fixed lending term — Every loan runs for 30 days and cannot be adjusted; configurable terms arrive in Basic PRO
  • No reporting module — Consolidated reports and statistics begin at Basic PRO
  • No database diagnostics — Integrity checks on your library tables begin at Basic PRO
  • No backup or restore — Snapshotting and recovering your library is a Basic PRO capability
  • Records are handled one at a time — Cloning, and bulk delete, activate and deactivate across modules, begin at Basic PRO
  • Limited data tooling — Import and export cover the essentials; broader data management and maintenance workflows come with the paid editions
  • No member requests — Members cannot submit borrow or return requests for staff approval; available from Basic PRO
  • No WordPress account import — Turning existing site users into members in one action is Full PRO
  • No member self-service circulation — Self-checkout and self-return from the frontend, with optional staff approval, are Full PRO
  • No reservations — Placing a hold on a title that is currently out is Full PRO
  • A single administrator — Additional Librarian and Circulation Staff roles are Full PRO
  • No permission matrix — Deciding what each role may see and do is Full PRO
  • No automated correspondence — Email templates and notification rules are Full PRO
  • Fixed form fields — Adding, hiding and reordering form fields is Full PRO
  • Fixed portal wording — Rewriting the portal’s labels and messages is Full PRO
  • No commercial channel — Selling PDFs and eBooks through WooCommerce is Full PRO

In short: Basic PRO lifts the ceilings and adds the operational tooling a busy collection needs. Full PRO adds delegation, automation and member self-service on top.

Basic Premium Features

Basic PRO keeps every free capability and removes the constraints that hold a growing collection back.

➜ Unrestricted capacity — Every record ceiling is lifted. Catalogue as many titles, members, categories, bookcases, sections and branches as your collection actually requires.

➜ Reporting and statistics — A dedicated reporting area that turns circulation activity into figures you can act on and present: what is moving, what is idle, who is overdue.

➜ Backup and restore — Capture a complete snapshot of your library whenever you choose and restore it to the same site or a different one. Indispensable before a migration, a major upgrade or end-of-term archiving.

Full Pro Add-ons

Full PRO is the complete system: everything above, plus the delegation, automation and self-service capabilities larger libraries depend on.
